messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired: db-conn-exhaustion-prod (PD link: https://pd/redwood/INC12345) — Service: postgres-primary. Severity: P1. Runbook: check connections, pgbouncer, app error rates.
Alice Carter: Acked. I'm on it — pulling metrics and traces.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-12345 — on-call engineers notified. Handoff channel: #eng-oncall.
Ben Li: @Alice can you confirm whether this is a spike in active connections vs idle? I can start looking at pgbouncer and top queries.
Alice Carter: 500s from /checkout and /chat. Traces show "could not obtain a connection" from pool and frontend 503s after ~30s.
Carla M.: primary postgres max_connections at 500/500. pgbouncer shows many waiting clients, conn_pool queue depth growing.
Dinesh Kumar: I'll scale read replicas temporarily to take pressure off primary for read-heavy paths. Spawning 2x read-replica nodes now.
Ben Li: pgbouncer snapshot:
```
SHOW POOLS;
# database: main
# total_clients=1024 active=980 waiting=44
```
Ben Li: looks like app side allowed too many connections (no global cap per instance). Might be a leak or sudden traffic spike.
Alice Carter: Immediate mitigation: enabling app-side connection throttling — set JDBC maxPoolSize=80 and trigger rolling restart of 5 pods (one-by-one). Rolling restarts started.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation scheduled in 5m if not acknowledged by Database team.
Carla M.: Customer impact summary: payments failing (~3% of global requests), chat latency heavily degraded. CS and support paged for customer notice.
Alice Carter: Restarted 3 pods — DB connections dropped from ~980 to ~320, errors decreased but pgbouncer still shows queueing for some transactions.
Dinesh Kumar: Adjusted pgbouncer: reserve_pool=50, max_client_conn=2000 to avoid immediate connection refusal. Paused noncritical background workers to reduce churn.
Ben Li: Relevant log sample:
```
2026-03-12T14:22:31Z ERROR db: could not get connection: timeout after 20000ms
2026-03-12T14:22:33Z WARN  pgbouncer: client_wait: 42s
```
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert auto-resolved (PD:INC12345) — incident acknowledged and mitigations applied.
Alice Carter: Handoff: @Ben — please own follow-up diagnostics (connection leak vs traffic burst, slow queries, pgbouncer tune). I'll take lead on customer comms and timeline.
Ben Li: Taking handoff. I'll open a postmortem ticket, collect metrics (connection histogram, per-instance pool use), and trace long-running queries.
Carla M.: Post-incident actions: add connection pool metrics to service-level dashboards, enforce instance-level max connections, and test transaction pooling mode in staging. Creating PR for runtime config changes.
Dinesh Kumar: Added temporary notes to runbook: run replica scale recipe, reserve_pool trick, and app-level caps. We'll plan an infra change to warm pool on deploy.
Alice Carter: :thumbsup: Once Ben has the postmortem ticket, we can close this thread. Thanks all for quick triage.
